Created [index.html](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t2_r5/work/index.html) with the complete single-file brick-breaker game implementing all requirements:

- **5 Levels**: Five distinct brick layouts (`LEVEL_LAYOUTS`), advancing on clearing all bricks and displaying `"You win"` upon clearing Level 5.
- **Lives & Scoring**: Starts with 3 lives (`"Game over"` screen at 0 lives), awards points per broken brick, and tracks the best score.
- **Status Bar**: Displays `"Score: N"`, `"Lives: N"`, `"Level: N"`, and `"Best: N"` in both the DOM status bar and canvas HUD.
- **Controls & Shortcuts**: Playable via Left/Right arrow keys and mouse movement; `Space` or mouse click launches the ball; `P` toggles pause (`"Paused"` screen with all movement frozen); `N` skips to the next level.
- **Persistence**: Saves and restores the current level and best score via `localStorage` across page reloads.
